mapper.sql: id, kind, dedup_key, subject, body, created, mailed_at, outcome
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_notice (kind, dedup_key, subject, body) VALUES (#{kind}, #{dedupKey}, #{subject}, #{body}) ON CONFLICT (dedup_key) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: UPDATE admin_notice SET mailed_at = now() WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM admin_notice WHERE mailed_at IS NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) RETURNING
mapper.update: UPDATE admin_notice SET outcome = #{outcome} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM admin_notice WHERE kind LIKE #{kindPrefix} || '%' AND dedup_key LIKE #{keyPrefix} || '%' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM admin_notice WHERE dedup_key LIKE 'layer-%:' || #{layer} || ':%' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
